feedback: The illustration faithfully depicts Jesus leading his disciples along a stony olive grove path under a crescent moon, effectively capturing the somber nighttime atmosphere.
The illustration faithfully captures the somber nighttime setting in the olive grove and Jesus addressing his weary disciples.
The illustration captures the somber Gethsemane setting, moonlight, and Jesus's anguished prayer, though he remains upright rather than fully prostrate as the text describes.
The artwork effectively captures Jesus praying tearfully beneath the night sky, matching the overall reverent setting despite his hands being open rather than placed directly on his chest.
The illustration faithfully portrays Jesus praying in deep agony within Gethsemane while being comforted by an angel.
The illustration depicts Jesus and the sleeping disciples among olive trees well, though the scene appears as daylight rather than a cool night.
The illustration accurately depicts Jesus waking the drowsy disciple in the olive grove while torches approach in the background.
The illustration perfectly captures Judas betraying Jesus with a kiss under dramatic torchlight, surrounded by an armed, hostile crowd.
The illustration effectively captures Jesus gently healing the servant's bleeding ear amidst the armed crowd and the sword-wielding disciple.
The illustration perfectly captures Jesus standing with calm dignity and bound wrists amid torch-bearing guards in the night olive grove, seamlessly matching the accompanying text.
